files.note: Read scan_folder, read_file, on_share, real_folder and the size/count caps; checked junctions, links, stamps and the byte cap. Only a message/behavior mismatch at the byte cap remains, and an existing test pins the behavior, so no finding.
Read Parser, clean, user_words, drop_image_markers, image_url, Tail read/page_before/older_page and the home/follow helpers; checked caps, partial lines, CRLF and image markers. No provable defect.
Read ChatEvent, parse_line, init, step_view, assistant, result, user and empty_init_alarm; checked malformed and unknown lines against the locked chat tests. No provable defect.

Read the engine lifecycle (spawn, read_stdout, send, stop, watch_idle, start, close) and the CHAT-01 echo/replay handling; checked idle limits and the agent arguments. Behavior matches the locked replay tests.

Read chat_finish, remote_path, local_path, find_blocker, finish_blocked, wrap_up and status_entries. R7-F01: a blocked finish skips untracked folders reported as dir/ and then force-removes the worktree, losing their files.
Read cap, questions_of, diff_lines, card, patch_cards, the claude/omp/codex step mappers and codex_output; checked long diffs, patch grammar and caps. No provable defect.
Read figures, conclude, read_with, finish, scrub and Claim; checked window choice, sign-in kinds, line scrubbing and one read per home. No provable defect.
Read replace_with, clear_stale_copies, natural_key, file_list, path_kind and the open/launch helpers; checked temp copies, non-UTF-8 names, fences and path shapes. No provable defect.
Read OpenLimit, external_url, system_open, host_path, fence, reveal, open_choice, editor_open and the path/program guards; checked UNC, WSL, shares and program types. No provable defect.

Read bucket, claude_lines, codex_lines, scan, Cache/Held and read_from; checked bands, forks, growth and save retry. A timestamp-less codex event may lose its delta, but the intent is not provable, so no finding.
